WF9 roots can move Fe to the xylems and WF9 tops can move Fe from the xylems to the tops.

the WF9 genotype has a superior ability to move Fe to the leaves and that this ability is related to the production of citric acid by the roots.

citric acid is the main Fe-chelating acid in maize root saps and stem exudates and that Fe-citrate is the form of Fe that moves in the xylem.
